message: IP 192.0.2.10 has multiple names: app.internal, www.internal. Reverse DNS will use the first primary hostname only.
Name 'app.internal' contains a dot. In BIND this is relative unless you add a trailing dot. It will become 'app.internal.example.com'.
Name 'www.internal' contains a dot. In BIND this is relative unless you add a trailing dot. It will become 'www.internal.example.com'.
